english.note: Use 冇問題 when something is acceptable, when you are fine with it, or when a relationship has no hard feelings.

exampleSentences.english: Changing the time? No problem; I’m cool with it.
exampleSentences.traditional: 改時間？冇問題，我冇所謂。
